description.en: Connector to a separately installed and started Windows GUI Runtime. Recommend 0.1.9; require 0.1.6+ authenticated HTTP MCP and review/continue tools, with actual capability checks. Configure trusted loopback runtime_url and connection_token; bind MCP and Skill to Pi. You deploy and stop Runtime separately. Disabling/uninstalling this connector does not stop/uninstall Runtime or delete its data. External model APIs may charge usage fees.
description.zh-CN: 连接器：需自行单独安装、配置并启动 Windows GUI Runtime。建议使用 0.1.9；要求具备 0.1.6 起提供的鉴权 HTTP MCP 和审核／继续工具，并核对实际能力。填写可信本机 runtime_url 和 connection_token，将 MCP 与 Skill 绑定 Pi。Runtime 由用户独立部署和停止；停用／卸载本连接器不会停止、卸载 Runtime 或删除其数据。外部模型 API 可能按用量收费。

runtime_url.title: Trusted loopback MCP URL / 可信本机 MCP 地址

connection_token.title: Local MCP connection token (not a model API key) / 本机连接密钥（不是模型 API key）
